findings.current: “A meeting? What kind of lunatics came up with this schedule? It’ll take at least seven days just to reach Hubei!”
findings.defect: The translation drops 주야, which explicitly describes seven complete days and nights.
findings.rationale: 아무리 빨라도 칠 주야 specifies the minimum travel time as seven day-and-night cycles.
findings.replacement: “A meeting? What kind of lunatics came up with this schedule? Even at the fastest pace, it’ll take seven days and nights just to reach Hubei!”
findings.source: “회의? 어떤 정신 나간 놈들이 이따위 일정을 짰어? 호북까지 가는 데에만 아무리 빨라도 칠 주야는 걸리겠다!”

findings.current: In short, he was telling them to screw themselves.
findings.defect: 배 째라 is a defiant refusal meaning “do your worst,” not an instruction for the planners to screw themselves; the current version redirects the hostility and alters the pragmatic force.
findings.rationale: The idiom expresses Jeok Cheongang’s willingness to ignore any consequences rather than a direct insult aimed at a particular group.
findings.replacement: In short, he was telling them to do their worst.
findings.source: 한 줄 요약하자면, 배 째라는 소리다.

findings.current: “You haven’t even dried the blood on your head yet.
findings.defect: The Korean idiom is rendered as an unnatural literal image instead of its established English equivalent, and 놈’s insulting address is weakened.
findings.rationale: 대가리에 피도 안 마르다 describes someone as extremely young and inexperienced, equivalent to “wet behind the ears.”
findings.replacement: “You little punk, you’re still wet behind the ears.

findings.current: To do that, I had plenty of things to deal with in both Murim and the modern world.
findings.defect: The draft omits that Taekyung must go back and forth between the two worlds, a mechanical detail supporting why overland travel would leave him less time.
findings.rationale: 오가며 explicitly means traveling back and forth, not merely having business in both places.
findings.replacement: To do that, I had a lot to take care of while going back and forth between Murim and the modern world.
findings.source: 그러기 위해서는 무림과 현대를 오가며 처리해야 할 일들이 많았다.

findings.current:
“I’ve gained some insight recently, but even after racking my brain and thinking about it until I nearly died, there are parts I simply can’t understand. If we travel overland, there won’t be enough time for you to teach me.”

“Instruction…”

“I’m saying there’s something I can never figure out on my own, no matter how much I think about it.”
findings.defect: The draft moves Taekyung’s emphatic plea ahead of Jeok Cheongang’s reaction, mistranslates 죽었다 깨어나도 as merely thinking until he nearly died, and then replaces the source’s escalation with a repetitive paraphrase.
findings.rationale: The source first introduces the need for instruction, pauses for Jeok Cheongang’s interested response, and only then intensifies the claim with the idiom 죽었다 깨어나도, “even if I died and came back to life.”
findings.replacement:
“I’ve gained some insight recently. If we travel overland, there won’t be enough time for you to teach me.”

“Instruction…”

“There are parts I could never understand on my own, no matter how hard I rack my brain over them—even if I died and came back to life.”
findings.source:
“근래에 얻은 깨달음이 있는데, 육로로 이동하게 되면 가르침을 받을 시간이 충분하지 않습니다.”

“가르침이라…….”

“저로서는 도저히, 머리를 쥐어 싸매고 고민을 해 봐도, 죽었다 깨어나도 알 수 없는 부분이 있어서 그렇습니다.”

findings.defect: The current line sanitizes the deliberately vulgar portmanteau 취랄 and sounds as though Taekyung is actually drunk.
findings.rationale: 취랄 blends 취하다 with the profanity 지랄, mockingly turning Taekyung’s claim of drunkenness into a vulgar accusation that he is talking nonsense.

findings.defect: The translation removes the strong profanity from Taekyung’s deliberately reckless insult about the Slaughter Saint.
findings.rationale: 좆밥 is strongly vulgar, and that vulgarity is central to the joke and Mungyeong’s ensuing killing intent.

findings.current: He considered it for a moment, then clicked his tongue.
findings.defect: The physical action is changed: 입맛을 다시다 means smacking one’s lips, whereas clicking one’s tongue is a different gesture with a different emotional implication.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes Jeok Cheongang smacking his lips after deliberating; the later sentence 끌끌 혀를 찬 is the actual tongue-clicking action.
findings.replacement: He considered it for a moment, then smacked his lips.

findings.current: Just as Mu Song, the owner of the ship, was about to answer, Jeok Cheongang stepped between them.
findings.defect: The subject is reversed: Jin Wikyung is about to answer Mu Song, not Mu Song about to answer someone else.
findings.rationale: 진위경이 is the explicit subject of 대답하려던, while 무송의 말에 identifies the statement he was answering.
findings.replacement: Just as Jin Wikyung was about to answer Mu Song, the owner of the ship, Jeok Cheongang stepped between them.
findings.source: 배 주인, 무송의 말에 진위경이 대답하려던 그때. 적천강이 두 사람의 사이를 가로막았다.

findings.current:
Mu Song’s eyes grew misty.

It had been a long time since he had felt the warmth of human kindness.
findings.defect: Splitting and reversing the clauses weakens the explicit causal relationship: feeling human warmth after a long absence is what makes Mu Song’s eyes redden.
findings.rationale: The modifier 사람의 온기를 느낀 directly explains Mu Song’s emotional reaction in the main clause.
findings.replacement: Feeling the warmth of human kindness for the first time in ages, Mu Song’s eyes grew misty.
findings.source: 실로 오랜만에 사람의 온기를 느낀 무송의 눈시울이 붉어졌다.

findings.defect: The draft reduces Cheongpung’s muffled but meaningful offer to an uninterpretable noise.
findings.rationale: With his mouth full, Cheongpung is garbling an invitation to eat the dumpling, as Mu Song’s immediate clarification 먹으라고? confirms.

findings.current: Pushover—no, Mungyeong was looking at me with concern.
findings.defect: The callback again sanitizes 좆밥, weakening the repetition that connects Taekyung’s earlier insult directly to Mungyeong’s retaliation.
findings.rationale: The narration deliberately repeats the same vulgar term Taekyung just used for the Slaughter Saint.
findings.replacement: Fucking pushover—no, Mungyeong was looking at me with concern.
findings.source: 좆밥. 아니 문경이 걱정스러운 얼굴로 나를 바라보고 있었다.

summary: Two scene actions are mistranslated, including the speaker in the ship dispute; several pragmatic, causal, and register details are also lost or softened.
